modifications: Filled stroke outline path data (`d`), median path data, stroke order and the 1024x1024 coordinate system are copied unchanged from AnimCJK svgsJaKana SVGs (no rescaling). Split outline parts of one stroke are grouped into a single logical stroke. Reformatted into JSON. Stroke-number positions, start-direction arrows and end anchors are computed by NichiGo from the median/outline geometry (not AnimCJK data); medians are never drawn. `ending` values are NichiGo-owned metadata from scripts/kana-strokes/nichigo-endings.json, not AnimCJK data, and are not rendered.
